title: Open Horizon Research Foundry: results
description: Pre-registered, verified tests of quantum compilers, null results included. Result 1: a budgeted reordering of existing Qiskit, pytket and PyZX passes did not beat GUOQ on 145 fresh QAOA circuits (null). Result 2: an audit of Qiskit, pytket and PyZX found no new wrong output (fallback). Result 3: an automated bug-triage test failed under its own rule. Each record, plan and data set is in the archive; run python check_results.py to re-check every result.
